messages:
nina: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: observed a short window of cross-region routing flips that coincided with TLS handshake timeouts and retry storms. Creating action items here.

omar: Ack, I can own the route-change inventory + recent deploy diff. Target: Tue EOD.

tess: I'll take the TLS side: gather handshake failures, SNI, and client-side retry counts. Will correlate with omar's timeline.

ryan: I captured a short pcap showing SYN retries then RST after 2s. Looks like route churn causes connection drops before TLS can complete.

```
15:04:12.001 IP 10.20.30.5.52340 > 34.55.66.77.443: Flags [S], seq 1000, win 65535
15:04:12.201 IP 10.20.30.5.52340 > 34.55.66.77.443: Flags [S], seq 1000 (retry)
15:04:14.300 IP 10.20.30.5.52340 > 34.55.66.77.443: Flags [S], no ACK -> timeout
```

nina: Proposed remediations: 1) add alert: cross-region egress retry >1.5% sustained 5m, 2) small config change: increase route-stability hold from 8s->45s for critical egress, 3) build a canary that simulates cross-region cutover to measure retry amplification.

tess: +1 on alerts. I'll draft an alert and a short playbook snippet for immediate mitigation (rollback route change & enable local-eject).

omar: I'll populate a spreadsheet with all recent routing PRs and owners and link it here.

sre-bot: Reminder: add action items to incident tracker -> https://redwood.tools/incidents/2187654321 (automated reminders on).

ryan: Note: persistent connections behave differently; any canary must test both long-lived and new sessions.

nina: Owners & deadlines: route inventory (omar) Tue EOD; TLS correlation (tess) Wed AM; alert + playbook (tess) Wed PM; canary (ryan & nina) next Fri. Schedule 30m sync Thu to review progress.

omar: Added sheet & initial owner mapping.

tess: Will open PRs in infra-alerts and runbooks and post links here.

nina: Thanks. If anyone sees another spike, paste region, pod-id, and short log snippet here so we can correlate quickly. Reopen at Thu sync or after PRs land.
